Connect the Shipment Log

The planner reads and writes each job's collaboration Shipment Log tab through a small Google Apps Script web app that runs as Daniel (I-5 Shipment Log API). Easiest: open the script's web app page while signed in to your i5design.com account and click Connect Load Planner. Or paste the two values here. They stay in this browser only.
